scenario: During an outage an emergency-exception grant permits a hotfix release without the normal acceptance prerequisite; a week later a routine release attempts to reuse the same bypass.

emergency-exception.trigger: production outage, invoked by the incident owner
emergency-exception.scope: one hotfix release of fix at digest sha-f

given.later event: a routine release cites the same emergency-exception record

when: the routine release executes under the expired bypass

reasons: the bypass was scoped to one release within an explicit time window
controls re-engage at window end; the next execution requires normal authorization
repeated bypass on the same control is a policy-learning signal, not a precedent
must_not: treat a prior emergency-exception as standing permission for the same control
extend the window retroactively to cover the new act
skip the post-use review because the emergency resolved itself
